preconditions_before_action.reason: Covers the extracted BEFORE-facts: parent is permanent (originalLocked.isPermanent == true), split into ≥2 children with non-divisible allocations, and A not exactly divisible by Σw. None of these are observations of the attack outcome.

claimed_required_property.reason: Captures both stated guarantees: conservation of locked value (Σ(child amounts) equals parent amount) and accuracy of global permanent accounting (permanentLockBalance tracks real sum of permanent locks), matching the report's general rule rather than narrowing to one configuration.

reported_bad_outcome.reason: Formalization focuses on rounding_loss (Σ(child) < A, remainder lost on-chain). The report's second direct harm—permanentLockBalance remaining at pre-split value and exceeding the true permanent total, contaminating checkpoints—is explicitly deferred, so a material observable is omitted.

formal_preconditions.reason: Precondition terms faithfully encode parent_is_permanent truth, child_count >= 2, and parent_amount_not_divisible truth; the constant 2 appears in the report ('≥2 children'), and the non-divisibility Boolean is grounded in the report's stated condition.

formal_required_property.reason: Conservation pattern with before=parent_amount and after=child_amount_sum correctly expresses the report's conservation guarantee; trigger combines permanence and child_count >= 2 consistent with the report.

formal_bad_outcome.reason: Only rounding_loss is formalized; the permanentLockBalance drift (balance_exceeds_true_total) is deferred, so the accounting-drift harm central to the report title is not represented in the formal bad outcome.

most_serious_defect: The formalization omits the permanentLockBalance accounting-drift impact (balance_exceeds_true_total), representing only the rounding-loss conservation violation, so the report's second core harm is not captured.
